ModMetaData.name: Colony Task Auditor
ModMetaData.author: pengin0503
ModMetaData.description:
Monitors construction, mining, deconstruction, production bills, sowing/harvesting, unfinished products and milking/shearing, and diagnoses why tasks stall (workers, skills, materials, forbidden, reservations, reachability) with an explicit confidence level. Stalled tasks are shown in an alert and a list window. Diagnosis only: it never forces jobs, deletes orders or changes settings. Requires Harmony.
建築・採掘・解体、製造指示、播種・収穫、未完成品、搾乳・毛刈りを監視し、作業が止まっている原因（作業者・スキル・材料・禁止・予約・到達性）を確信度付きで診断します。停滞はアラートと一覧ウィンドウで確認できます。診断専用で、作業の強制・指示の削除・設定の変更は行いません。Harmonyが必要です。
